swan-reach-observatory.name: Swan Reach Observatory
swan-reach-observatory.bio: Research-grade 70 cm telescope near Swan Reach, open to the public on pre-booked stargazing sessions.

notes.pin: Observatory on Murraylands Rd, Swan Reach SA 5354 (operator's address); pin the building, near the Swan Reach ferry side.
notes.cost: From $85 per SATC attraction listing; operator site gives no price. Entry strictly by pre-booking, opened 13 Nov 2025.

swan-reach-district-museum.name: Swan Reach and District Museum
swan-reach-district-museum.bio: Local history museum in a 1917 school building at Swan Reach, with the Mid Murray Classic Car Gallery of 16+ vehicles.
swan-reach-district-museum.ticket_note: No official site found; SATC listing only.

notes.pin: Former school building in Swan Reach township; pin the museum entrance.
notes.cost: No price found; assumed free/donation for a small volunteer museum, unverified.

river-murray-dark-sky-reserve.name: River Murray International Dark Sky Reserve
river-murray-dark-sky-reserve.bio: Australia's first International Dark Sky Reserve, 3,200 sq km along the Murray where the Milky Way shows clearly.
river-murray-dark-sky-reserve.wiki: River Murray International Dark Sky Reserve
river-murray-dark-sky-reserve.ticket_note: No single steward; SATC and park pages only.

notes.pin: Reserve core site is in Swan Reach Conservation Park (4WD only); visitors use public stargazing sites such as Shell Hill Reserve and the observatory. Pin a public-access viewing point, not the centroid, away from the observatory and Shell Hill pins.
notes.cost: Free to be in; guided tours priced separately by operators.

big-bend-walker-flat.name: Big Bend (Walker Flat)
big-bend-walker-flat.bio: Tallest cliffs on the Murray at its longest bend, with a lookout near Nildottie and a free ferry at Walker Flat.
big-bend-walker-flat.ticket_note: Council/regional tourism pages only; no single steward.

notes.pin: Pin the cliff lookout near Nildottie / Big Bend lookout, not the Walker Flat ferry landing.
notes.cost: Ferry is free; Big Bend by Night is a separate private farm tour, not priced here.

shell-hill-reserve.name: Shell Hill Reserve
shell-hill-reserve.bio: Five-million-year-old oyster-shell deposit near Swan Reach that doubles as a Dark Sky viewing site.
shell-hill-reserve.ticket_note: No official site; SATC listing only.

notes.pin: Reserve with car park on SATC listing; use the reserve's car park point (OSM/SATC).

ngaut-ngaut-conservation-park.name: Ngaut Ngaut Conservation Park
ngaut-ngaut-conservation-park.bio: Aboriginal heritage site at the Devon Downs rock shelter, visited only on guided tours led by Nganguraku guides.

notes.pin: Park is on the west bank of the Murray ~12 km south of Swan Reach near Nildottie; tours meet at a point given on booking. Pin the park's rock-shelter / Devon Downs access, or the tour meeting place if published.
notes.cost: $15 adult from a 2021 secondary source (concession $12.50, child $9); parks page says 'fees apply for tours' with no figure.

hunter-road-lookout.name: Hunter Road Lookout
hunter-road-lookout.bio: Free clifftop lookout over the Murray, Blanchetown and Paisley Wetlands, 2.3 km off the Sturt Highway.
hunter-road-lookout.ticket_note: No single steward; SATC listing only.

notes.pin: Lookout at the end of Hunter Road, Paisley, 2.3 km off the Sturt Highway; pin on the lookout platform.

brookfield-conservation-park.name: Brookfield Conservation Park
brookfield-conservation-park.bio: Park near Blanchetown known for southern hairy-nosed wombats and the Three Habitat Walk, with periodic closures for pest control.

notes.pin: Public section car park / Three Habitat Walk start near Blanchetown (parks.sa.gov.au); visitors use the Three Habitat Walk area.
notes.cost: Free entry per parks page; open 7am to sunset, closed on set dates through to Dec 2026 for pest control.

karoonda-art-sculpture-trail.name: Karoonda Art and Sculpture Trail
karoonda-art-sculpture-trail.bio: Walkable trail of sculptures along Karoonda's main street, including the Geofacts and the Karoonda Shuffle Screens.
karoonda-art-sculpture-trail.ticket_note: No dedicated site found; regional tourism pages only.

notes.pin: Main street (Railway Tce / Cleve-Karoonda area) in Karoonda; pin midway along the sculpture line, distinct from the silo art pin.

karoonda-silo-art.name: Karoonda Day and Night Silo Art
karoonda-silo-art.bio: Painted silos by Heesco showing country life and a steam train, with changing artwork projected on them after dark.
karoonda-silo-art.ticket_note: No official site; regional tourism pages only.

notes.pin: Silos at Karoonda railway siding; pin the silos.

karoonda-pioneer-park.name: Pioneer Park (Karoonda)
karoonda-pioneer-park.bio: Pioneer buildings, machinery, carriages and rolling stock, with a 1 km nature trail in the mallee, open to walk through.
karoonda-pioneer-park.ticket_note: No official site found; regional tourism pages only.

notes.pin: Pioneer Park, Karoonda (SATC lists a car park); pin park entrance.

lameroo-silo-art.name: Lameroo Silo Art
lameroo-silo-art.bio: Two painted grain silos by Smug, a 2024 and 2025 diptych, with a park beside them.
lameroo-silo-art.ticket_note: No official site; SATC and regional tourism pages only.

notes.pin: Grain silos at Lameroo with the adjoining park; pin the silos.
